description: How many tubes of caulk or sealant to buy: linear feet per cartridge for your joint width and depth (or a triangular corner bead), and cartridges for the total length. Formula: Cartridge volume = fl oz × 1.80469 cu in. Bead area = width × depth (or leg² ÷ 2). Linear feet per cartridge = volume ÷ (bead area × 12). Cartridges = length × (1 + waste) ÷ feet per cartridge.
name: calc_caulk
title: Caulk Calculator (Tubes of Caulk or Sealant per Linear Foot)
